name: NativeMidi_Active
description: Query whether a song is currently playing.

name: NativeMidi_DestroySong
description: Free a song and the resources it holds.

name: NativeMidi_LoadSong
description: Load a MIDI song from a file path.

name: NativeMidi_LoadSong_IO
description: Load a MIDI song from an SDL_IOStream.

name: NativeMidi_Pause
description: Pause playback of the current song.

name: NativeMidi_Quit
description: Shut down the native MIDI subsystem.

name: NativeMidi_Resume
description: Resume playback of a paused song.

name: NativeMidi_SetVolume
description: Set the volume applied to MIDI playback.

name: NativeMidi_Start
description: Start playing a song, replacing the one currently playing.

name: NativeMidi_Stop
description: Stop playback of the current song.
